description: Latest price for one livestock category in one region, from USDA MARS direct-trade and auction reports — the same series get_livestock_history extends over time. Use for a current quote; use get_livestock_history instead for trends. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Returns the most recent report's price and its unit (typically USD per cwt); direct-trade reports can skip weeks when no trades occur, and a category/region pair with no report returns a no-data error rather than a stale price.

geography.description: Region or state code (e.g. IA for Iowa direct trade, ECB for Eastern Cornbelt, or a state auction code). Default: IA

name: get_livestock_price
